prose: A Bloomberg excerpt indexed by Techmeme reports licensing scrutiny of Nscale’s proposed remote GPU access for ByteDance and a large customer-revenue concentration. The full report and underlying rules were inaccessible. An attributed licensing requirement does not establish denial, a violation or cancellation of the commercial arrangement.
highlights: Evidence is an indexed source report
Remote access is distinct from shipping hardware
Underlying legal text was not inspected
Need for approval does not establish denial
Reported revenue concentration was not audited
